headline: A maximum-severity Adobe ColdFusion flaw fell under active exploitation within minutes of a public technical write-up, while Google sued a phishing crew that weaponized its Gemini AI.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep collapsing the gap between disclosure and exploitation, weaponizing a maximum-severity ColdFusion flaw within minutes of watchTowr's public write-up as vendors now clock the discovery-to-exploit window at 29 minutes.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Adobe ColdFusion Flaw Under Active Exploitation

emerging_trends.text: Artificial intelligence now works both sides of the crime ledger, with Google suing a Telegram phishing crew that leaned on Gemini to build fake login pages while security teams warn AI writes unreviewed code straight into the software pipeline.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Google Sues Outsider Enterprise Over Gemini Abuse

emerging_trends.text: Law enforcement pressed hard on streaming-piracy crime, as Vietnam arrested seven operators of the HiAnime service and Japanese police charged a teenager who canceled 46,000 anime subscriptions.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Arrests Hit Anime Piracy and Streaming Fraud

topics.title: Adobe ColdFusion Flaw Under Active Exploitation
topics.latest_developments: Exploitation of CVE-2026-48282 broadened this week, with KEVIntel's honeypots catching the first hits on July 2 minutes after watchTowr published a technical breakdown of the flaw.
topics.summary: Adobe ColdFusion, a widely deployed web-application server, carries CVE-2026-48282, a CVSS 10.0 bug Adobe patched June 30, 2026; unpatched servers face full remote compromise, so administrators should apply the update immediately.

sources.title: Critical Adobe ColdFusion Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
Attackers exploit critical Adobe ColdFusion vulnerability (CVE-2026-48282)
Max severity Adobe ColdFusion flaw now exploited in attacks

topics.title: AI Enters the Software Build Pipeline
topics.latest_developments: Analysts at The Hacker News and BleepingComputer argued this week that AI now writes code directly into the build pipeline, folding a new class of unvetted machine-generated dependencies into a supply chain that SolarWinds, Log4Shell, and XZ Utils already battered.
topics.summary: As AI coding tools generate and commit software faster than humans can review it, they strip out the checkpoints where teams once caught security problems, widening the software supply-chain attack surface.

sources.title: What Changes When Your Software Supply Chain Includes AI Writing Your Code?
Software Is Now Written at the Speed of Thought. Security Isn't.

topics.title: Google Sues Outsider Enterprise Over Gemini Abuse
topics.latest_developments: Google filed suit against Outsider Enterprise, a Telegram-based phishing-as-a-service operation that coached customers to use Google's Gemini model to spin up counterfeit Google and YouTube login pages for text-message scam campaigns.
topics.summary: Outsider Enterprise sells ready-made phishing kits to low-skill fraudsters over Telegram; the lawsuit marks Google's attempt to choke off criminal abuse of its own AI models.

sources.title: Google Is Suing Chinese Scammers Who Are Using Gemini

topics.title: Arrests Hit Anime Piracy and Streaming Fraud
topics.latest_developments: Vietnamese police arrested and are prosecuting seven suspects who ran HiAnime, the largest anime piracy streaming site before its June shutdown, while Japanese police arrested a teenager near Tokyo who exploited a flaw in a subscription anime platform to cancel more than 46,000 users' subscriptions.
topics.summary: Two separate cases hit the anime streaming world: HiAnime's operators face prosecution in Vietnam, and a Japanese student faces charges for fraudulently voiding tens of thousands of paid subscriptions.

sources.title: Vietnam arrests suspects behind HiAnime anime piracy service
Japanese teen arrested over cyberattack that disrupted anime streaming service

topics.title: Medtronic Notifies Nearly 4 Million of Breach
topics.latest_developments: Medtronic began notifying nearly 4 million people that the ShinyHunters intrusion into its corporate systems exposed their Social Security numbers and health data, and the company said it found no evidence the stolen records surfaced online.
topics.summary: ShinyHunters stole personal and medical records during an April 2026 breach of medical-device maker Medtronic's corporate IT; affected individuals should watch for identity theft and take up any monitoring offered.

sources.title: Major medical device manufacturer notifies nearly 4 million of breach

business_politics.title: French Court Clears Le Pen to Run for President
business_politics.latest_developments: A French appeals court on July 7 upheld Marine Le Pen's embezzlement conviction but cut the sentence that had barred her from public office, freeing her to run.
business_politics.summary: The ruling lets National Rally leader Marine Le Pen stand in France's 2027 presidential election, reversing a lower court's ban tied to her conviction for embezzling European Parliament funds, though electronic monitoring could hamper her campaign.

sources.title: French Appeals Court Allows Le Pen to Run in Next Year’s Presidential Race
French far-right leader Le Pen cleared to run for president

business.title: Mic Drop Nightlife Venue Coming to the North Shore
business.latest_developments: Mic Drop, a karaoke and dueling-pianos entertainment concept, will open in 4,321 square feet on North Shore Drive.
business.summary: The venue pitches itself as an immersive nightlife destination with live music and social experiences on Pittsburgh's North Shore near the stadiums.

sources.title: New entertainment concept with karaoke, dueling pianos and more to open on Pittsburgh’s North Shore

business.title: Penn Township Industrial Park Adds Grocery and Lounge
business.latest_developments: The owners of a Penn Township staffing and screening company are opening an all-in-one grocery store, restaurant, and fitness center at their industrial park.
business.summary: In Westmoreland County's Penn Township, a longtime staffing and screening business is diversifying into retail and dining, its most unusual pivot after decades adapting to changing economic times.

sources.title: Why a Penn Township industrial park now has a grocery store and lounge

around_town.title: McCandless Unifies Its Volunteer Fire Departments
around_town.latest_developments: McCandless is drafting a single combined set of bylaws to govern its three volunteer fire departments under one paid fire chief.
around_town.summary: The town is replacing three separate rulebooks with one unified structure meant to streamline and guide operations across its volunteer fire companies.

sources.title: McCandless pursues 1 set of bylaws for 3 volunteer fire departments

around_town.title: Court Weighs Pitt Police Records Exemption
around_town.latest_developments: A denied open-records request over University of Pittsburgh police enforcement during pro-Palestine protests reached a judge on appeal.
around_town.summary: The appeal challenges whether the University of Pittsburgh Police Department can claim exemption from Pennsylvania's right-to-know laws covering how it policed campus demonstrations.

sources.title: A legal challenge questions Pitt police’s exemption from right-to-know laws

around_town.title: Flood Risk Persists Across the Region
around_town.latest_developments: Forecasters placed significant parts of the Pittsburgh area in NOAA's excessive-rain outlook every day for the next five days, with Friday likely to become a First Alert weather day.
around_town.summary: Scattered afternoon storms could bring renewed flash flooding across Allegheny County and western Pennsylvania, KDKA meteorologists said, after a stormy holiday week.

sources.title: Scattered afternoon storms could bring more flood risks to the Pittsburgh area

events.title: Mini Golf at the Westmoreland Museum
events.latest_developments: A summer-long miniature golf exhibition inside the Westmoreland Museum of American Art in Greensburg is drawing a broad range of visitors.
events.summary: The Westmoreland Museum of American Art in Greensburg has installed a playable miniature golf course as a summer exhibition, pairing art with a family activity.

sources.title: Miniature golf experience is a hole-in-1 for Westmoreland Museum of American Art

team_usa.title: Balogun Says He Had No Role in Ban Reversal
team_usa.latest_developments: Folarin Balogun said July 7 he played no part in the process that cleared him to face Belgium, calling the decision 'controversial.'
team_usa.summary: The U.S. striker's red-card suspension was lifted before the round-of-16 loss, a reversal that set off a FIFA-UEFA feud; Balogun said he accepts the outcome but did not seek it.

sources.title: Balogun confirms no involvement in ban U-turn

reading.summary: Zitron dissects SoftBank's 46th annual shareholder meeting and Masayoshi Son's rambling presentation, arguing the conglomerate's AI-era pitch is more spectacle than substance.

reading.title: Beware of Productivity Paradoxes
reading.summary: Newport revisits how the personal computer, once a sure bet for productivity gains, failed to deliver them cleanly, a cautionary lens for judging today's claims about AI at work.
